message_text: Every section of ENG 101 is full. I NEED this class to graduate on time.

I understand the urgency. You can: 1) Join the waitlist for your preferred section, 2) Check for newly added sections during the first week, or 3) Contact the English department about a capacity override.
There's no waitlist option showing up for me.
The waitlist feature is only available during the registration period. If the period has closed, you'll need to contact the English department directly for an override.
What's their contact info? I can't find a directory anywhere on this site.
The English department can be reached at english@university.edu or 555-0167. Office hours are Monday-Friday, 9am-4pm in Humanities Building, Room 305.
